summary: Completed comprehensive testing of HEMELEY iteration 5 features: Admin account CRUD (create/delete/deactivate all account types with privileges), Vendor profile settings tab, and Vendor messaging reply. Fixed a critical bug in routes_admin.py where MongoDB collection truth testing was failing. All 15 backend API tests passed. All frontend UI tests passed.
passed_tests: Admin login with admin@hemeley.com / hemeley2024 (role: admin)
POST /api/admin/create-account - vendor account with privileges (trust_rate, default_rating, is_verified)
POST /api/admin/create-account - customer account with loyalty_points
POST /api/admin/create-account - delivery account
POST /api/admin/create-account - admin account
POST /api/admin/create-accounts-bulk - bulk create multiple accounts
PUT /api/admin/users/{id}/deactivate?role=vendor - deactivate vendor
PUT /api/admin/users/{id}/activate?role=vendor - activate vendor
DELETE /api/admin/users/{id}?role=vendor - delete vendor
PUT /api/admin/vendor-profile - update vendor name, phone, zone, description, hours
Vendor login with vendeur@hemeley.com / hemeley2024
GET /api/vendors/messaging/conversations - get vendor conversations
GET /api/admin/vendors - get all vendors
GET /api/admin/customers - get all customers
GET /api/admin/delivery-partners - get all delivery partners
GET /api/admin/stats - get admin stats
Admin dashboard loads with Vue d'ensemble, Vendeurs, Livreurs, Commandes, Clients, Paramètres tabs
Admin Vendeurs tab shows 'Créer un vendeur' and 'Import en masse' buttons
Admin Create Account modal shows account type dropdown and privilege fields
Admin Vendeurs tab shows Actif/Inactif, Activer/Désactiver, Supprimer buttons per vendor
Admin Clients tab shows 'Créer un client' and 'Import en masse' buttons
Admin Clients tab shows Désactiver and Supprimer buttons per customer
Admin Livreurs tab shows 'Créer un livreur' and 'Import en masse' buttons
Admin Livreurs tab shows En ligne/Hors ligne, Désactiver, Supprimer buttons per delivery
Vendor dashboard loads with Paramètres tab
Vendor Paramètres tab shows all fields with Modifier buttons (Nom, Email, Téléphone, WhatsApp, Zone, Description, Heures d'ouverture, Heures de fermeture)
Vendor Messages tab shows conversation list
Vendor can click conversation to open detail view with messages
Vendor can type and send reply message
Vendor reply appears in conversation with correct styling (orange bubble on right)

bugs_fixed.issue: MongoDB collection truth testing error - 'Collection objects do not implement truth value testing'
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed 'if not collection:' to 'if role not in collection_map:' pattern for activate_user, deactivate_user, and delete_user endpoints

seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_ prefixed accounts during testing (vendors, customers, delivery partners, admins) via admin create-account and bulk-create endpoints
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 5 features fully tested and working: Admin can create/delete/deactivate ALL account types (vendor, delivery, customer, admin) with privileges (trust_rate, default_rating, is_verified, loyalty_points). Bulk import works. Vendor Settings tab shows all editable fields with Modifier buttons. Vendor messaging reply works - vendor can see conversations, open them, and send replies. Fixed MongoDB collection truth testing bug in routes_admin.py. CAMPAY payment integration remains MOCKED on frontend.
